Build GSEA Benchmark Controls

Source: R/04i-BenchGSEAConfig.R
BenchGSEAConfigSet.Rd

Collects the arguments of a GSEA benchmark into the bench_config list of BenchGSEAConfig(). Arguments matching fgsea::fgsea() formals are handed over to it; all other named arguments are kept as-is.

Usage

BenchGSEAConfigSet(sc_data, pathway, group = NULL, ...)

Arguments

sc_data

A Seurat object to be screened. It defines the cells that group assigns labels to.

pathway

A named list of gene sets, each element a character vector of gene symbols. Passed to the pathways argument of fgsea::fgsea().

group

character or NULL. Per-cell group labels, one per cell in sc_data. The vector is stored in bench_config and validated by BenchGSEAConfig(). Default: NULL.

...

Additional named arguments, typically further fgsea::fgsea() controls (e.g. nperm, scoreType). Case variants of the function's own arguments are resolved to their canonical names.

Value

A list of parameters for fgsea::fgsea() and BenchGSEAConfig().

See also

Other ConfigSet: BenchGeneScoreConfigSet(), BenchMemoryConfigSet(), MethodParamSet()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
config <- BenchGSEAConfigSet(
  sc_data = sc,
  pathway = fgsea::examplePathways,
  group = sc$cell_type
)
} # }
